description.zh: 电量、充电状态和剩余时间；低于你设的那条线变警示色，台式机直说「没有电池」
description.en: Battery level, charging state and time left; turns a warning colour below your line, and says so on a desktop with no battery

help.zh: 电量低于这个数就变警示色，下面那行也会提醒你插电。填 0 等于关掉这条提醒 —— 系统自己说快没电时，卡片照样会红。
help.en: Below this the card turns a warning colour and the line below asks you to plug in. 0 turns that reminder off, but the card still reddens when Windows itself reports critically low.

help.zh: 关掉之后只剩状态那一行，卡片安静一点。这个时间只有用电池时才有 —— 插着电谈「还能用多久」没有意义。
help.en: Off leaves just the state line. That estimate only exists on battery: while plugged in there is nothing to count down.

items.zh: 电量百分比，以及系统说没在充电。两个数都由 Windows 给，组件不推算。
items.en: The battery percentage, and whether Windows says it is charging. Both come from the system; the card works nothing out by itself.

items.zh: 插着电还是用电池 —— 这两件事决定下面那行字说不说、说什么。
items.en: Plugged in or on battery decides whether the line underneath says anything at all.

items.zh: 剩余时间是 Windows 自己估的，不是组件按电量算的。
items.en: The time left is Windows' own estimate, not something the card derives from the percentage.

items.zh: 节电模式开着的话，标题旁边多一个小标记。
items.en: When battery saver is on, a small tag appears next to the title.

items.zh: 台式机没有电池，卡片会直说「没有电池」，而不是画一个 0%。
items.en: A desktop has no battery: the card says so instead of drawing a misleading 0%.

items.zh: 只有用电池的时候才有这一行。插着电谈「还能用多久」是错的。
items.en: That line only exists on battery. Counting down while plugged in would be wrong.

items.zh: 系统给的秒数往下取整，所以整分钟数可能比实际少一点。
items.en: The system reports seconds; they are rounded down, so the whole minutes can read slightly short.

items.zh: 读数超过一周按坏读数处理 —— 宁可不说，也不印「还剩 11811 小时」。
items.en: An estimate beyond a week is treated as broken: better silence than "11811 h left".

items.zh: 刚插拔电源的那一拍可能还是旧读数，半分钟内会自己纠正。
items.en: The tick right after you plug or unplug may still show the old reading; it corrects itself within half a minute.

items.zh: 强调色：正在充电。
items.en: Accent colour: charging.

items.zh: 普通文字色：电量正常。
items.en: Normal text colour: the level is fine.

items.zh: 警示色：低于你在属性面板里设的那条线，或者系统自己说快没电了。
items.en: Warning colour: below the line you set in the inspector, or the system reports critically low.

items.zh: 下面那行字会跟着换：「该插电了」和「马上就要关机」不是同一件事。
items.en: The line underneath changes with it: "plug in when you can" and "about to shut down" are not the same thing.

items.zh: 告警线：低于这个百分比就变警示色，出厂 20%。
items.en: Warn below: the percentage where the card turns a warning colour. 20% out of the box.

items.zh: 显示剩余时间：关掉之后只留状态那一行，卡片更安静。
items.en: Show time left: off leaves just the state line, which makes the card quieter.

title.en: It stops when you cannot see it

items.zh: 每半分钟问一次，挂在平台的时间轴上；卡片藏起来整条就停了。
items.en: It asks every half minute on the platform's timeline, which stops entirely while the card is hidden.

items.zh: 卡片不记「上次的电量」，重新看得见的第一拍就是当前读数。
items.en: Nothing about the last reading is remembered: the first tick after it is visible again is already current.

items.zh: 属性面板里没给「系统指标」权限时，卡片会直说缺的是哪一项。
items.en: Without the system monitor permission the card names the permission it is missing.

items.zh: 浏览器预览里没有系统调用，卡片显示「没有读数」—— 那不是坏了。
items.en: The browser preview has no system calls, so the card reads "no reading". Nothing is broken.

items.zh: 授权之后半分钟内自己恢复，不用重开卡片。
items.en: After you grant it, the card recovers within half a minute; no need to reopen it.

changes.zh: 第一个版本：电量、充电状态、剩余时间和节电模式，每半分钟从平台读一次。
changes.en: First release: level, charging state, time left and battery saver, read from the platform every half minute.

changes.zh: 告警线可以调，剩余时间那一行可以关。
changes.en: The warning line is adjustable and the time-left line can be turned off.

changes.zh: 台式机说「没有电池」，而不是画一个 0%。
changes.en: A desktop says "no battery" instead of drawing a 0%.
